class.name: SteamInventorySnapshot
class.brief_description: A detached inventory read and its observation metadata.
class.description: A snapshot remains readable after the Steam client stops. Steam can return cached inventory when an application refreshes rapidly. An unchanged result may also lack freshness evidence. Inspect [member freshness] before relying on this snapshot as a current view.

method.name: get_items
method.description: Returns the read-only array of present item instances.

method.name: get_freshness
method.description: Returns the SDK evidence available about the age of this view.

method.name: get_observed_at_unix
method.description: Returns steam's result timestamp in Unix seconds, or zero if unavailable.

members.member: The read-only array of present item instances.
The SDK evidence available about the age of this view.
Steam's result timestamp in Unix seconds, or zero if unavailable.

constants.constant: Steam supplied no freshness evidence. This includes selected reads and full results that Steam may have served from cache or found unchanged.
Steam announced a newer full view for this exact request.
Steam returned readable data with an expired result status.
A dedicated server verified the signed selection and its age for a currently authenticated owner. The snapshot describes the selected instances at the proof timestamp.
